text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is a horsegirl who transferred to Tracen
Academy after achieving brilliant results on the regional circuit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today on the training track, she was already drawing
the keen attention of quick-eared Trainers...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the run, Oguri Cap.
...Heh, hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...? Why are you laughing?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, my apologies if I offended you. It was just such a fruitful
session that I couldn't help but feel delighted.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I was well aware of your countless fierce victories on the regional
circuit... but running beside you, I truly felt it for myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap—you possess formidable strength.
I look forward to locking horns with you upon the turf.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see. Then next time, let us race.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, so that's Oguri Cap...! To run alongside the
"Emperor" Symboli Rudolf and keep such a cool composure...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
And to challenge her directly to a race just like that...!
She must have nerves of pure steel...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it is almost time for my regular meeting.
If you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let us do this again sometime, Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, where is she headed...? Could she be off to do
some secret training somewhere else...?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Could that be the secret to her speed?
I've got to see this!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Hey rookie, are you curious about Oguri too?
Well then, let's follow her together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside the other Trainers,
I decided to follow Oguri Cap, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmh...?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text: ...S-She's taking a really long time to start training.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
No, this is Oguri Cap we're talking about.
There has to be a deeper meaning behind this...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text: She came right back here again...?! What is she doing?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: I-Is she just... kind of eccentric...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
T-This is hopeless. She's walked in circles around the same spot four times...
I have zero clue what's going on in her head...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Is she really as capable as they say...?
Well, maybe we'll come check on her another day...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bewildered by Oguri Cap's inexplicable behavior,
the Trainers left one after another.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Nnngh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, noticing that Oguri Cap actually looked
somewhat troubled, I couldn't help but ask—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It is strange. No matter how much I walk,
I keep ending up back in the exact same spot.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Does this academy have four different places
that look entirely identical...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Lost... Hmm, perhaps so.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, who are you?
Now that I think about it, you are an unfamiliar face.
choice_data_list: I'm a Trainer here at the academy.
I'm one of the Trainers at this academy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
An academy Trainer...
Then do you know the way?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I want to get back to the dorms.
Could you please tell me how to get there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that Oguri Cap was indeed lost,
I gave her directions back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see. Understood. Thank you.
...Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few minutes after watching Oguri Cap
walk away—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What...?! The same face as that Trainer earlier...?
Could you be... my doppelganger?!
choice_data_list: No, you just looped back to where you started!
No, you just walked right back to the same spot!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so?
Now that you mention it, the scenery is identical.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Distinguishing city scenery is difficult. The buildings are so close together,
and they all look alike... It is completely different from back home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Back home, navigating was simple. You turned right at Tome-san's field
for the school. The bus stop was left at Shige-san's big storehouse.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tome-san often gave me mikan for a snack.
...They were delicious. I miss them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There are times when I miss it.
...However, I cannot go home just yet.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tome-san, Shige-san, Chiyo-san, Yoshi-san...
They all sent me off to the Central League, praying for my success.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Far away in my hometown,
there are people rooting for my victory.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to live up to their expectations—no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Oguri Cap spoke those words,
her gaze was unwavering.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I must get going.
The dorms are this way, right? Alright, this time for sure—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I was worried, so I ended up escorting
Oguri Cap all the way to her dorm.
